supersedes_execution_recommendations_of.retained: Historical calculations and 75 per-object evidence references remain unchanged; this revision is not permission to execute either document.

hardware_observation.method: Read-only SSH lscpu/free/df/lsblk/proc-pressure/vmstat/docker-stats; subsequent findmnt and selected container state inspection. No source contents, credentials or database queries.
hardware_observation.vmstat_swap_in_out_and_iowait_observed: 0 in displayed samples; not a sustained workload measurement
hardware_observation.pg32_and_pg32b: running and healthy; started timestamps unchanged from prior evidence
hardware_observation.limitation: Idle observations cannot prove sustained throughput, SSD endurance, thermal margin, application response latency or absence of later contention. No stress test or software installation was performed.

scope.per_object_read_and_sort_limits: Retain prior draft ceilings; runtime restrictions below take precedence. Do not combine with old per-table hash execution.

proposed_digest_strategy.caveat: Logical reads, not storage allocation or guaranteed physical SSD traffic. Excludes business queries, sorting, builds and retries. No reuse of the snapshot verifier's member digest as an atomic batch precondition.
proposed_digest_strategy.before_batch: Validate exact approved scope/budget/input digests; run unchanged full verify_snapshot; then establish a batch-local source identity and explicitly hash the complete SQLite file with cancellation/time checks and identity checks around hashing.
proposed_digest_strategy.during_batch: Read one table at a time; retain path/symlink/sidecar/stat identity, schema, type, value, row/cell/byte/time/VM and cleanup checks. No table result may claim standalone source digest verification; results remain provisional within the batch.
proposed_digest_strategy.after_batch: After all cursors/connections close and all owned sort workspaces clean successfully, recheck identity and hash the complete SQLite file, then check identity, cancellation and unchanged metadata again. Only then publish the entire batch's draft result using the existing staged/fsync/no-clobber discipline.
proposed_digest_strategy.failure: Any object failure, cancellation, cleanup failure or final digest mismatch rejects the entire batch; no successful final batch artifact or automatic next batch.
proposed_digest_strategy.api_compatibility: Keep existing open_sqlite_values and summarize_sqlite standalone completion semantics and default hashes unchanged. Add a narrowly scoped batch-owned path; do not expose a free skip_hash flag or label provisional object reads as independently verified.
proposed_digest_strategy.stationary_input_requirement: Read-only project snapshot mount plus an operational no-writer window remains mandatory. Pre/post hash and metadata checks do not create an atomic snapshot or protect against every concurrent privileged writer. Never use immutable SQLite mode while knowingly allowing updates.

proposed_runtime.small_medium_scratch_backing: tmpfs included in container memory consumption
proposed_runtime.large_scratch_backing: Private disk-backed directory under configured runtime root; application byte ledger is not a filesystem quota

stop_conditions.host_swap_out: Positive delta of /proc/vmstat pswpout across two consecutive sample intervals
stop_conditions.immediate_conditions: Lost monitoring/SSH, invalid metrics, disk floor breach, container OOM/exit, source integrity failure, pg32 or pg32b stops or becomes unhealthy, or user cancellation
stop_conditions.action: Cancel only the exact named one-shot candidate container; bounded TERM then KILL and verify absence. Preserve incomplete evidence and stop later batches; never restart unrelated services or retry automatically.

proposed_runtime.threshold_basis: Conservative project-specific starting thresholds for this shared 2-core/8GB host, not official performance guarantees. Recalibration requires measured canary evidence and explicit approval.
proposed_runtime.priority_and_io: Use low scheduling priority inside the actual worker, not merely on the Docker client. ionice is best effort and depends on scheduler/kernel behavior; no hard I/O isolation is claimed. Verify effective limits before real reading. Do not install iostat or alter host cgroups/services in this revision.
proposed_runtime.timeouts: Prior group outer timeouts are failure ceilings, not forecasts. Half-CPU operation may hit them; do not enlarge automatically. Host monitoring must cover full snapshot checks too, which currently lack an internal cancellation callback.
proposed_runtime.staging_policy: First authorize and validate synthetic batch tests and candidate limits. Then, under separately approved real-read scope, run small first and evaluate measured peaks/stalls/time before medium and large. Failure stops all later groups. No full Task8 claim.

required_synthetic_checks_before_executi: Count complete SQLite hashes: two per batch, unchanged two per standalone object
Reject source replacement, modified bytes, sidecars and identity drift before/during/after batch
Reject early iterator close, middle-table failure and cancellation during final hash without any final artifact
Reject malformed or mismatched scope/budget and preserve standalone API completion semantics
Confirm cleanup plus staged persistence/fsync failure cannot publish a successful batch
Exercise resource metric parsing, threshold streaks, lost monitor, exact-container cancellation and timeout orphan checks without touching real source or other services
changes_this_turn: Non-executing budget/document revision only; no product code, builds, tests, synchronization, source value reading, database access, Git commit/push or service changes.
